title: Dulquer Salmaan Lines Up Two Confirmed Telugu Films, Third Reported
excerpt: Aakasamlo Oka Tara opens November 20, 2026, Sri Sri is still shooting in Hyderabad, and a Mythri Movie Makers romantic comedy is reported but not yet confirmed.
body:
• Dulquer Salmaan's next Telugu-language film, Aakasamlo Oka Tara, directed by Pavan Sadineni, releases in theatres worldwide on November 20, 2026.
  • His second Telugu film in the lineup, Sri Sri, is a romantic drama directed by Ravi Nelakuditi with Pooja Hegde as female lead; it was still shooting in Hyderabad in early November.
  • Reports in 123Telugu say a further straight Telugu film with Mythri Movie Makers, said to be a romantic comedy possibly directed by Deepak Reddy, is in discussion — but it has no official confirmation yet.
  • For US viewers: Aakasamlo Oka Tara opens November 20, 2026; check local theatre listings closer to the date, as no US streaming date has been announced in the sources.

Dulquer Salmaan is building a Telugu slate that now runs to at least two confirmed films and one reported project. The Malayalam star's next release is the Telugu-language drama Aakasamlo Oka Tara, which opens worldwide on November 20, 2026, according to The Hollywood Reporter India. A second Telugu film, Sri Sri, is in production, and entertainment outlet 123Telugu reports he is lining up another Telugu project with a major banner.

Aakasamlo Oka Tara: the confirmed November release

Aakasamlo Oka Tara is a Telugu drama directed by Pavan Sadineni, with story and screenplay by Gunnam Gangaraju. It introduces Satvika Veeravalli in the lead role, with Shruti Haasan in a supporting part and Dulquer Salmaan as Krishna. The teaser, released on October 17, centres on Kalpana, played by Veeravalli, a young woman from a rural village who aspires to become an astronaut. Salmaan's character recognises her potential and supports her pursuit, The Hollywood Reporter India reported.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=h3ElWvu31dc

The film's music is by GV Prakash Kumar, cinematography is by Sujith Sarang and editing is by K.L. Praveen. It is jointly produced by Sandeep Gunnam and Ramya Gunnam under Geetha Arts, Swapna Cinemas and Lightbox Media. The Hollywood Reporter India noted that the film marks Salmaan's return to a Telugu leading role after Lucky Baskhar (2024), Sita Ramam (2022) and Mahanati (2018).

Sri Sri: still shooting, new date expected

The second confirmed Telugu title is Sri Sri, a romantic drama directed by Ravi Nelakuditi with Pooja Hegde as the female lead. According to 123Telugu, the team was shooting an important scene in Hyderabad in early November, at AVN Institute of Engineering and Technology, with the key cast taking part. The film was originally scheduled for December 4, 2026, but 123Telugu reported the team is likely to announce a new date. Sudhakar Cherukuri is producing under SLV Cinemas, with GV Prakash Kumar composing the music.

Readers should treat the December 4 date as superseded until the makers announce a replacement. No new date was given in the reports read for this article.

A third Telugu film? Reports, not confirmation

Beyond the two confirmed titles, 123Telugu reported on November 14 that Salmaan will soon collaborate with Mythri Movie Makers for another straight Telugu film, said to be a romantic comedy expected to be directed by Deepak Reddy. The same report was explicit that official confirmation is yet to be made. That distinction matters: the Mythri project is reported buzz, not an announced film, and neither its title nor a release window has been confirmed.

"A beautiful classic cinema is on its way …… all cinema lovers get ready for this."

— GV Prakash Kumar, composer, on the Aakasamlo Oka Tara teaser, via The Hollywood Reporter India

Why Telugu, and what to watch next

Salmaan's Telugu run is unusual for a Malayalam lead because each of his earlier Telugu films was a straight Telugu production rather than a dubbed release, and the new lineup follows the same pattern: Aakasamlo Oka Tara and Sri Sri are both Telugu-language films. For diaspora viewers in the US, the immediate date is November 20, 2026 for Aakasamlo Oka Tara in theatres. The next confirmations to watch are a revised release date for Sri Sri and any official announcement from Mythri Movie Makers about the reported third film.
